verdict.rationale: Exporting a workspace is a fair question for a project-management tool, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no first-party export feature that preserves comments, attachments, and audit trails. The REST API endpoints and file download URLs are developer building blocks for building an export, not the export capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know that exporting my workspace preserves full history—comments, attachments, and audit trails—not just task titles
